description: Defines the QuicEndpointBase class and related classes for simulating QUIC protocol endpoints in a network simulator, including packet handling, connection management, and multiplexing.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase
classes.description: Represents a network endpoint in the QUIC simulation, capable of sending and receiving packets, managing a connection, and logging traces.

classes.name: QuicEndpointMultiplexer
classes.description: Handles multiplexing multiple QUIC endpoints on the same host, routing packets to the appropriate endpoint.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase::Writer
classes.description: Handles writing packets into the outgoing queue, simulating network transmission.

classes.name: QuicEndpointBase::DataProducer
classes.description: Produces stream data for QUIC streams, including crypto data.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::DropNextIncomingPacket
methods.description: Drops the next incoming packet to simulate packet loss.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::AcceptPacket
methods.description: Handles incoming packets received by the endpoint.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::RecordTrace
methods.description: Enables logging of connection trace data.

methods.name: QuicEndpointBase::OnPacketDequeued
methods.description: Callback when a packet is dequeued from the outgoing queue.
